quarry_

north-ledger · eu-central

Welcome, Priya.

Your first database
is running.

It’s called north-ledger, it lives in Frankfurt, and it’s yours to break. Four commands take you from an empty schema to a shell.

$ curl -fsSL quarry.example/i | sh
$ quarry login
$ quarry link north-ledger
$ quarry shell
north-ledger=> select 'hello' as world;

01

Connect from your laptop

Run quarry link in any project, and your shell gets credentials that expire in an hour. Nothing to paste into a .env file.

02

Load a sample

Fill it with two million real journeys from London’s bike hire scheme, so your first queries have something to say.

03

Ask it something

Open the console and run the query we left in it. It finds the busiest docking station before 9am, in about forty milliseconds.

Open the console

Or read the quickstart

WHAT THE FREE TIER HOLDS

of storage

If anything gets in your way, reply to this email. It comes to the four of us who answer support, and one of us will write back today.

Tomás, for the Quarry team
